quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Take away thy opinion, and then there is taken away the complaint, "I have been harmed." Take away the complaint, "I have been harmed," and the harm is taken away.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: The universe is transformation: life is opinion.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: For nowhere either with more quiet or more freedom from trouble does a man retire than into his own soul

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Do not act as if thou wert going to live ten thousand years. Death hangs over thee. While thou livest, while it is in thy power, be good.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: In the morning when thou risest unwillingly, let this thought be present,—I am rising to the work of a human being.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Such as are thy habitual thoughts, such also will be the character of thy mind; for the soul is dyed by the thoughts.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: The best way of avenging thyself is not to become like [the wrong-doer].

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Take care that thou art not made into a Caesar, that thou art not dyed with this dye; for such things happen.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: Look within. Within is the fountain of good, and it will ever bubble up, if thou wilt ever dig.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: If thou art pained by any external thing, it is not this thing that disturbs thee, but thy own judgment about it. And it is in thy power to wipe out this judgment now.

quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius
quotes.text: No longer talk at all about the kind of man that a good man ought to be, but be such.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: There are things which are within our power, and there are things which are beyond our power.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of things.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: Demand not that events should happen as you wish; but wish them to happen as they do happen, and you will go on well.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: You can be unconquerable if you enter into no combat in which it is not in your own power to conquer.

quotes.author: Epictetus
quotes.text: Remember that it is not he who gives abuse or blows, who affronts, but the view we take of these things as insulting.
